name: outlook
description: Read local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM, schedule meetings (fuzzy directory search, free/busy, and an unsent meeting draft you send yourself), and print a day as a PDF planner. It can never send anything. Windows only; requires pywin32.

search_folders.title: Search folders
search_folders.description: Optional. Comma-separated folder names for outlook_search_recent, e.g. 'Inbox,Sent Items,Archive'. The Python interpreter and the folders this server writes to come from the suite-wide EVA_PYTHON, EVA_KNOWLEDGE_DIR (saved email goes to its 'email' sub-folder, which must exist) and EVA_DOCUMENTS_DIR (printed day planners go to its 'pdf' one) environment variables; see the plugin README.

blacklist_file.title: Blacklist file
blacklist_file.description: Optional. Path to a file of extra content-blacklist terms, one per line.

calendar_hours.title: Printed day hours
calendar_hours.description: Optional. The working day the printable planner's timeline starts from, e.g. '7-19'. Defaults to 8-18, and always stretches to fit anything scheduled outside it.

calendar_colours.title: Calendar category colours
calendar_colours.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the planner already reads the colour Outlook holds against each category and prints it at full strength. Set this only to overrule one, e.g. 'Leadership=purple,Client=green'. Names: red, orange, peach, yellow, amber, green, teal, olive, blue, purple, maroon, rose, steel, silver, slate, black, grey, each also with a 'dark-' prefix. Uncategorised events fall back to External / Internal / Personal.

meeting_hours.title: Meeting booking hours
meeting_hours.description: Optional. The hours a meeting may be SUGGESTED in, e.g. '8-18'. Defaults to 9-17. Separate from the printed day hours above: what you want to see on a planner and when it is acceptable to book you are not the same window.

allow_drafts.title: Allow meeting drafts
allow_drafts.description: Optional. Set to 'false' to remove outlook_draft_meeting, leaving the server read-only on the mailbox. Left blank, drafting is on: it saves an UNSENT meeting into your calendar for you to review and send. Nothing in this server can ever send anything.

gal_scan_cap.title: Directory scan cap
gal_scan_cap.description: Optional. How many address-list entries one fuzzy name search may read before giving up (default 20000). Raise it on a very large Global Address List if people are not being found; a search that stops early says so.
